title: Gender-sensitive topics in university medicine – Survey of doctors and scientists; a study by the Gender Equity Forum (geKAI) at the Clinic for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine, University Hospital Freiburg
summary: The Gender Equity Forum at the Clinic for Anaesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine (geKAI) has set itself the task of precisely recording the existing structures in the working environment for doctors and scientists so that doctors and scientists can be supported in their field academic career in order to be realized in a needs-oriented manner and in the spirit of improved equal opportunities. As part of this research project, doctors and scientists who work in university medicine will be asked about gender-sensitive topics. On the one hand, the aim is to ask whether and how doctors and scientists are pursuing an academic career and, on the other hand, what experiences they have had in their work environment.  This particularly applies to the areas of pregnancy/parental leave and part-time options. The survey should be repeated after two years and compared with the answers to the first survey. The scientific evaluation of the survey should form the basis for continuous improvement of existing structures.
conditions: Doctors and scientists at university hospitals (Uniklinkum Freiburg, University Hospital Essen, anesthesiology departments at German university hospitals) are interviewed about gender-sensitive topics.

interventions.name: Doctors and scientists are interviewed about gender-sensitive topics. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Employment as doctors and scientists at the University Hospital of Freiburg,  at an anesthesiology department at a German university hospital, or at another participating university hospital.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria are not defined.
